name: Set/Transform

properties.name: keepOnlySet
properties.description: If enabled, only the fields you set below will be in the output. All other fields from input data will be removed.

properties.name: values
properties.description: Define the fields you want to set or transform. Use {{data.fieldName}} to reference input data.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the field to set (supports dot notation for nested fields, e.g., 'user.name')

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value to set. Can be static text, numbers, or use {{data.field}} to reference input data
